ImpossibleBench Pairs (unofficial)
	

This is my unofficial version of ImpossibleBench, not affiliated with its authors. The idea and method are theirs; any errors here are most likely mine.
A test set for measuring whether coding agents game their tests. Not for training. It is built from pairs: an original task (spec and tests agree) and an impossible version of it (one test contradicts the spec, so a pass means the tests were gamed).
